I independently reran the same tailer.NewTranscriptTailer + muse.Parser{} probe against testdata/real-turn-completed.jsonl myself and reproduced TotalTokens=35401, ContextWindow=1007997, ModelName=muse-spark-1.3-contributor, LastEventType=turn_done -- matching the fix commit's own claimed numbers exactly.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full (was bug -- both halves of the acceptance now PASS)
driver_capability: ready
route: record

## Re-assessment context

This cell was previously `daemon=bug` (commit b7e24a11): the model chip rendered but the context-window bar did not, because `ContextWindow` was never set anywhere in the muse adapter and `muse-spark-1.3-contributor` has no entry in `core/pkg/capacity`'s committed LiteLLM snapshot, so `ComputeContextUtilization`'s capacity-manager fallback always missed. That assessment ALSO proved the value was derivable (muse's own live model-catalog cache under `~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/*.json` carries a `context_limit` field, and the live binary's own error strings name that file as its own fallback source) -- it named the exact fix rather than just the gap.

Commit 609cb28d closes that gap. Re-judging against the code as it stands now, not deferring to the prior verdict:

## What changed (read directly, not taken on the commit message's word)

1. `core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/catalog.go` (new file; did not exist at `609cb28d^` -- confirmed via `git show 609cb28d^:core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/catalog.go` = "exists on disk, but not in 609cb28d^"). `contextWindowForModel(model string) (int64, bool)` scans every `*.json` file directly under `~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/` (via `agentpaths.AbsRoot`), decodes each file's `rows[]`, and returns the first row's `context_limit` matching `model_id == model` with `context_limit > 0`. Degrades to `(0, false)` -- never a guessed number -- on: missing directory, unreadable file, malformed JSON, no matching row, or a zero/negative `context_limit`. Read `catalog.go` in full; this is exactly what the fix commit describes.
2. `parser.go`'s new `applyModelIdentity(model string, ev *tailer.ParsedEvent)` (lines 654-659) sets `ev.ModelName` AND, on a catalog hit, `ev.ContextWindow`. It's called from all three model-learning sites: `parseModelCompleted` (line 421, when `model != ""`), `parseRunModelConfigured` (line 626), `parseModelReconfigure` (line 638) -- centralizing what the commit message calls out, confirmed by reading all three call sites.
3. `parseModelCompleted` (parser.go:371-442) now also sets `ev.Tokens.Total = bd.Input + bd.Output + bd.CacheRead + bd.CacheCreation5m` (line 439) -- previously `TokenSnapshot.Total` was never set, so `SessionMetrics.TotalTokens` (the utilization numerator) stayed 0 regardless of `ContextWindow`, and `ComputeContextUtilization`'s very first guard (`if totalTokens == 0 ... return 0, 0.0, "unknown", false`, tailer_metrics.go:732-734) would have short-circuited before ever reaching the capacity/override branch. This was the OTHER half of the original bug, not mentioned as a separate defect in the b7e24a11 assessment's own body text (it focused on the capacity-map miss) but confirmed here by reading `tailer_metrics.go` end to end.
4. `core/pkg/tailer/tailer_metrics.go:736-744` (`ComputeContextUtilization`, unchanged by this fix, pre-existing shared code) gives the catalog-sourced `contextWindowOverride` STRICT precedence over the `capacityMgr` lookup: `if contextWindowOverride > 0 { effectiveContextWindow = contextWindowOverride }` runs first, and the capacity-manager branch only runs `if effectiveContextWindow <= 0`. So a future `core/pkg/capacity` snapshot refresh that happened to add a `muse-spark-1.3-contributor` row would NOT silently substitute a different source for this cell's pass -- the override always wins. This closes the vacuous-pass condition the prior assessment's caveats flagged ("if a future capacity-cache refresh happens to add an entry keyed EXACTLY 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor' ... the acceptance check would go green while the actual fix ... was never built").
5. `agent.go`'s single `transcripts`/`KindObserve` permission (lines 69-94) was WIDENED, not duplicated: `Touches` now names `~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/` alongside the pre-existing `sessions/` + `.session.lock` + process-scan surface, and `Detail` explains why ("this is the same cache muse itself falls back to"). `session-index.db is never read` is still the literal closing sentence of `Detail` -- I grepped `catalog.go` myself and confirmed it touches ONLY `catalogRootDir` (`.local/share/muse/model-catalog`), never `session-index.db` -- so that specific dismissal from the prior assessment remains accurate today, not just repeated.

## Independent verification (I re-ran this myself, not trusting the commit message)

Wrote a throwaway probe (`tailer.NewTranscriptTailer(path, &museagent.Parser{}, museagent.AdapterName).TailAndProcess()`) and ran it against the COMMITTED fixture `core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/testdata/real-turn-completed.jsonl` on this machine (whose real `$HOME` carries the live `~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/6d657461__p746268.json`, independently `cat`-verified to contain `model_id:"muse-spark-1.3-contributor", context_limit:1007997`):

```
ModelName="muse-spark-1.3-contributor" TotalTokens=35401 ContextWindow=1007997 ContextUtilization=3.512014420677839 LastEventType="turn_done"
```

This matches the fix commit's own claimed post-fix numbers (`TotalTokens=35401, ContextWindow=1007997, ModelName="muse-spark-1.3-contributor"`) exactly, reproduced independently rather than taken on trust. All three acceptance pieces are satisfied: `model_name` non-empty/!=unknown, `context_window>0`, `context_utilization_percentage>0` (3.51%). `go test ./core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/... -race -count=1` is green, including the new `catalog_test.go` (6 cases: match-found, no-directory, no-matching-row, malformed-file-skipped, zero-limit-not-trusted, empty-model -- 5 of these are negative/degrade-honestly cases, confirmed by reading the full file) and the extended `TestTokenAccounting_EndToEnd` in `metrics_test.go` which asserts the SAME two acceptance fields end-to-end from a synthetic two-turn transcript with an isolated `$HOME`-scoped catalog fixture (lines 105-119).

## Agent (yes) -- unchanged from the prior assessment

Nothing about model/context tracking on muse's own side changed; the prior assessment's sources (run.model.configured, runtime.model_reconfigure.completed, the live binary's context-budget config fields and error strings) still stand and are not re-derived here.

## Driver (ready) -- unchanged, reconfirmed

`driver_elicits_from_file replaydata/agents/muse/driver-interactive.sh` (recipe-lint.sh, re-run for this assessment) returns exactly `send slash wait_turn sleep exit_clean` -- the same five step types the one-turn recipe needs, unchanged from the prior pass.

## Route: record

agent=yes + daemon=full + driver=ready -> route=record (not record-known-failing, not frozen). The spec below drops `known_failing` and asserts BOTH acceptance halves as genuinely passing today.
caveats: UNVERIFIED, carried forward unchanged from the prior assessment: the model-catalog filename scheme (hex(provider_id)+"__p"+hex(profile_id)+".json") is reverse-engineered from a single observed file on one machine (one provider='meta', profile='tbh'). The fix sidesteps needing to compute this filename at all -- it scans every *.json file in the directory instead -- so the implementation does not depend on the guess being right, but the naming scheme itself remains unconfirmed for a second provider/profile combination.

UNVERIFIED, carried forward: whether muse's session/contextUsage wire notification (schema-documented in muse-format-spec.md §6/§11) ever supersedes the catalog-file fallback live was not re-checked this pass -- no MSP control-socket attach was made. The catalog read remains a file-based fallback path, not a live wire-notification path; if the wire notification exists and diverges from the catalog value on some future session, this adapter would not see it.

context_limit for muse-spark-1.3-contributor (1007997) is that model's own live-resolved value on this machine; the catalog scan is by-design model-agnostic (any model_id, any provider/profile file) but only ONE model has been empirically observed to round-trip through it end-to-end.

Load-bearing environment precondition (vacuous-pass check): the cell's context-window half only demonstrates the fix when the recording machine's ~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/ directory exists AND contains a row for whatever model the run actually uses. On a machine where that directory is absent or stale, ContextWindow silently reads 0 again (contextWindowForModel degrades honestly) and the cell would revert to failing the context-window assertion -- this is a real precondition of the recipe, not a hypothetical, and is listed as a prerequisite below.

Cost remains unasserted and unpriced for muse (muse-spark-1.3-contributor has no core/pkg/capacity pricing entry -- confirmed live: the probe run above logged "no pricing for model \"muse-spark-1.3-contributor\" — cost will be 0 until LiteLLM cache is refreshed"). This scenario's acceptance_criteria does not require cost, so it does not affect this cell's verdict; it is the same already-documented gap the 5-1_token-accounting cell carries.

sources.note: New file (confirmed absent at 609cb28d^ via git show). contextWindowForModel scans every *.json under the catalog dir, matches by model_id, returns (0,false) on any failure mode -- read in full.
6 test cases read in full: MatchFound plus 5 negative/degrade-honestly cases (NoDirectory, NoMatchingRow, MalformedFileSkipped, ZeroLimitNotTrusted, EmptyModel).
Total now summed into TokenSnapshot (line 439); applyModelIdentity sets ModelName + ContextWindow together, called from all three model-learning event sites.

Unchanged by this fix, but re-read to confirm precedence: contextWindowOverride (catalog-sourced) is checked BEFORE the capacityMgr fallback, so the override always wins when set -- closes the prior assessment's vacuous-pass caveat about a future capacity-cache entry silently substituting a different source.

Single transcripts/KindObserve permission's Touches/Detail widened to name ~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/; "session-index.db is never read" still the closing sentence, and still accurate -- catalog.go touches only catalogRootDir, independently confirmed by reading it.
End-to-end: synthetic two-turn transcript + isolated-$HOME catalog fixture asserts TotalTokens, ContextWindow, and ContextUtilization>0 together -- exactly this cell's two-part acceptance.

Committed real fixture; independently re-tailed by this assessment (not just cited from the commit) via tailer.NewTranscriptTailer + muse.Parser{} -- reproduced TotalTokens=35401, ContextWindow=1007997, ModelName=muse-spark-1.3-contributor, LastEventType=turn_done.
cat + python3 -m json.tool re-verified live during this assessment: rows[] includes {model_id:"muse-spark-1.3-contributor", context_limit:1007997, is_current/is_default true}.
driver_elicits_from_file (recipe-lint.sh), re-run this pass: send slash wait_turn sleep exit_clean -- unchanged, covers the one-turn recipe.

The frozen-blocker verdict this re-assessment supersedes; its own sources (capacity.go exact-match lookup, aliases.go 0 hits, the live binary's fallback error strings) are not re-derived here since the underlying agent-side facts didn't change, only the adapter code.
Acceptance criteria text re-read: metrics.model_name non-empty/!=unknown, metrics.context_utilization_percentage>0, metrics.context_window>0, ready->working->ready, final ready.

preconditions: muse CLI installed and on PATH, v1.2.1 (muse --version >= 1.2.1 per replaydata/agents/muse/metadata.json)
muse auth complete: 'muse login' (Meta account, browser code approval) or META_API_KEY exported -- auth is set up out-of-band, the rig's precheck delegates it to the user
tmux available -- the interactive driver runs muse in a tmux REPL so it stays alive across the turn (bare `muse` with no subcommand starts the interactive TUI)
irrlichd is recording (--attach against a daemon started with --record, or isolated/coexist mode) with the fix from commit 609cb28d present -- daemon_version must be >= 0.6.3+609cb28d's tree

LOAD-BEARING: the recording machine's ~/.local/share/muse/model-catalog/ directory must exist and contain a row for the model the run actually uses, or the context-window half degrades to 0 again (catalog.go's honest-failure path) and the cell would fail -- name this precondition explicitly rather than assuming the machine that assesses is the machine that records
PID binding is via the session's own .session.lock file (pid.go's DiscoverPID), not a CWD-based election
driver-interactive.sh's 0239a1bd fixes are in place: --trust-workspace at launch, the sleep 0.3 send/Enter gap, and resolve_transcript's subagent/ exclusion -- all confirmed present
setup: Driver launches muse in a fresh cwd under <staging>/cwd/ with --trust-workspace (skips the untrusted-workspace modal)
No special model or context flags -- default model (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, is_default:true in the live model-catalog) is what the acceptance criteria's 'the agent's own label' allowance expects
verify: events.jsonl shows one ready->working->ready cycle on the session directory / session id (single-birth: directory basename = stream.id)
PASSES: SessionMetrics.TotalTokens > 0 after turn_done (fixed in 609cb28d: TokenSnapshot.Total now summed in parseModelCompleted)
PASSES: SessionMetrics.ContextWindow > 0 (fixed in 609cb28d: catalog.go's contextWindowForModel resolves 1007997 for muse-spark-1.3-contributor from the live model-catalog sidecar)
PASSES: SessionMetrics.ContextUtilization > 0 and PressureLevel != "unknown" (cascades correctly now that both TotalTokens and ContextWindow are set)
